_doc: NVDM scope registry (spec 4.1). Append-only: ids are stable forever; adding a scope (or a new kind, via envelope.schema.json enum) is a routine MINOR change. kind values: city | region | basin | corridor | waterway | district | state | body | block | gram-panchayat. District ids are state-prefixed (tn-thanjavur) because district names collide nationally. mumbai is a region (full MMR, 9 corporations); kolkata is planned as a region.
